# Western Beats

> Western Beats (Western Beats Private Limited) is an Indian music distribution company and official Warner Music India partner. Independent artists and labels distribute singles, EPs and albums to 150+ streaming platforms — including JioSaavn, Gaana, Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, Amazon Music, Wynk and Hungama — with no upfront cost.

Key facts:
- Distribution is free: ₹0 upfront, no annual subscription and no per-release fee.
- Artists keep ownership of their master recordings.
- Submissions are reviewed within 24 hours; releases typically go live within 72 hours of approval.
- Free ISRC and UPC codes are included.
- Jio and Airtel caller tune (CRBT) distribution is included.
- Supports singles, EPs and albums, in Hindi, Punjabi, Haryanvi, Bhojpuri, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Bengali, English and other languages.
- AI-generated music is not accepted.
- Artist support by WhatsApp and email, Monday to Friday.
- Contact: contact@westernbeats.com · +91 70876 77767 · Instagram @wb_digital_
